headline: Warner Bros. Discovery to Report Second Quarter 2026 Results on Thursday, August 6
summary: Warner Bros. Discovery, Inc. (the "Company") (Nasdaq: WBD) today announced that it will report its second quarter 2026 results on Thursday, August 6, 2026 before the market opens. Links to the live webcast of the conference call as well as the earnings materials will be available in the "Investor Relations" section of the Company's website at https://ir.wbd.com/ at approximately 7:00 a.m. ET. The Company will host a conference call at 8:00 a.m. ET that same day to discuss the results.
